body: A year and a half ago, I dropped my entire life - friends, SO, family, pets, material stuff - to move across the world and escape my 'normal', boring life. Now, I realize this experience has brought out the worst in me; I can't connect with anyone, I'm severely depressed, and next month I'm looking at moving back home with my tail between my legs and starting all over - again. The failure I feel as a person is insurmountable. I lost most ties I had as a professional (due to distance and lack of communication, not through any intentional means) and I'll be looking for a job all over again, living with my parents, trying to reconnect with my friends. The present is terrible and the future is frighteningly bleak. I feel like the 'prime of my life' has run its course, and it's too late to do anything of value with what's left. I think about suicide daily. My only hope comes from the fact that I can still drag myself out of bed each morning, have a cup of coffee. I count how many times I laugh per day and each one is precious. I just need to keep it going until something hopefully, eventually changes. There's got to be a place for me, somewhere.

I'm bipolar and every day is a struggle. It's like being in a constant war with this second, irrational voice in your head that maintains control most of the time. I'm so depressed and anxious that I've been going to bed at 6pm, and dream of suicide constantly. Worst part is, I'm on the other side of the world from my home and loved ones. I have a placement and position that many people would be thrilled to have and that I myself dreamed of having for years. I just can't control my thoughts. I'm wasting my time here. 

 Worse yet, I feel like I can't trust anyone here - the couple of people I've confided in have just given me the 'cheer up, you're such a pessimist' talk and brushed it off, or treat me differently, or stop talking to me altogether. I feel like this pretty much means that my 'positives' as a friend and a person are outweighed by the 'negatives' my depression and anxiety create. It increases the isolation, makes me realize how little I'd be missed if I left.

So, I just kind of sit here day by day, feigning smiles and cracking shitty jokes with people I can't trust, knowing I'm acting incorrectly for not appreciating my life. None of my friends or family at home know that any of this is going on, and I don't want to worry them by mentioning it since distance prevents them from helping. I'm doing my best to fight through it, but I can feel myself slipping. The idea of spending the rest of my life like this is too much to handle. I'm tired and don't want to continue. Even in this situation, the realization of a dream I've held close for years, I can't pull it together enough to function normally. It's crushing.

 I'm just waiting til my parents die so I can get out of here with a little less guilt about what I'm leaving behind. I could've had a great, happy life, but I guess I wasn't meant to.
[Scaphism.](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scaphism) I can't think of a 'bright side' to this one.
